summary: Right-closed directed conversion used the wrong endpoint in its fractional-part parity comparison when r == deltai, potentially choosing the wrong decimal significand length. The fix uses two_fc - 1 for shorter intervals and two_fc - 2 otherwise, with the unchanged beta_minus_1 scale. The implementation reversal is exact and unique. However, the added compute_right_closed_directed_test uses two inputs that bypass the corrected equality branch; no other upstream test calls this routine. No detecting upstream test was established, so test is empty and the candidate should remain blocked. No builds or tests were run.
